title: Deterministic-time form-energy modulus for local correlations
question: Do the unchanged finite PAH semigroups satisfy a support-dependent deterministic-time correlation modulus uniformly in n and j, using only the pinned R-511 form-energy bounds?
purpose: Make the compact-time equicontinuity input in the preregistration explicit without converting stationary averages into stopping-time bounds or claiming the anchored semigroup limit.

frozen_scope.model: Exactly the immutable PAH-001 functional, original PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled Gibbs state and finite stationary semigroup P_(n,j)(t)=exp(t L_(n,j)).
frozen_scope.domain: The declared bounded gauge-invariant globally amplitude-l1-Lipschitz finite-prefix cylinder domain D and its sampled representatives S_(n,j)f.
frozen_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time t>=0 on a compact deterministic interval [0,T]; no stopping-time or physical-time interpretation.
frozen_scope.order: The preregistered j->infinity passage at fixed n followed by anchored n is unchanged; this checkpoint takes neither limit.
frozen_scope.normalization: Original labelled Gibbs normalization and directed-half reversible form; R-490/R-522 are not reinterpreted as pointwise bounds.

source_formulas.budget: B_f=2 D_f M_f^2+2 H_f L_f^2, where D_f,H_f are source root-count bounds and M_f,L_f are the declared sup and amplitude-l1-Lipschitz constants.
source_formulas.finite_spectral_step: For K_(n,j)=-L_(n,j), reversibility gives |d/dt C_(n,j)(f,g;t)|<=sqrt(E_(n,j)(S f)) sqrt(E_(n,j)(S g)).

hypotheses: The finite PAH generator is reversible and nonnegative in the directed-half form convention.
R-511 energy bounds hold for the same unchanged sampled observables at n>=max(N(f),N(g)) and all j.
Finite spectral calculus gives form contraction E(P_t h)<=E(h) and the derivative identity for deterministic times.
conditional_theorem.conclusion: The displayed deterministic-time modulus is uniform in n,j and t,s for each fixed f,g; its constant depends only on the registered source support and domain bounds.
conditional_theorem.role: This supplies the compact-time equicontinuity input for correlation comparisons. It does not identify any limit or process.

acceptance.primary: Recompute B_f and the modulus from source-derived root-count formulas with exact rational fixtures and verify deterministic-time monotonicity.
acceptance.independent: Reconstruct the energy budget and squared modulus with a different fixture and no primary import.
acceptance.hostile: Reject dropping the radial budget, confusing form energy with a full generator norm, changing the sign, or promoting the deterministic modulus to Aldous/path-space or physical convergence.
acceptance.lean: Prove nonnegativity, energy-product domination and exact rational budget/modulus fixtures; no measure or process theorem is claimed.

decision_rule.PASS: Accept only the scoped deterministic-time modulus when all replay lanes and Lean agree.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Keep the parent temporal objective open if any R-511 hypothesis or spectral step is not discharged.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Reserve for an exact contradiction to the displayed finite energy-to-modulus implication; a missing infinite-volume input is not a negative result.
